newsitem.title: USA: Boca resumes shipping Rockwell 56K modem.
newsitem.headline: Boca resumes shipping Rockwell 56K modem.

text.p: Boca Research Inc said Monday it resumed shipment of its 56 kilobit modem after a temporary halt due to problems with a Rockwell International Corp chipset used in the modems.

Tony Zalenski, Boca's president and chief executive, said that, "Fortunately, when the K56flex performance issue was identified, we had shipped only limited quantities of product to identifiable locations."
The Boca 56K Internet Modem is expected to carry street prices of from $149 to $169.
International availability of the product is subject to each individual country's certification requirements, it said.
